searchText: Can we add a minimum gas_target of 1024? In the extremely unrealistic scenario that for some reason we get a gas target below 1024, we are then stuck, because we `gas_target // 1024` is then 0, so we are unable to change the gas target. At the fork block, I should use the gas limit of the previous block and use that as gas target? There is a `min(...)` that prevents getting stuck. Yes. In fact, it is the same field in the block header, just renamed colloquially. 🙂 Yeah I assumed that was the case I don't see this `min`? It is only in the transactions, not at block level Sorry, I meant `max`. ``` expected_base_fee_per_gas = max(parent_base_fee_per_gas - base_fee_per_gas_delta, 0) ``` That is on the way down. Ah right ``` base_fee_per_gas_delta = max(parent_base_fee_per_gas * gas_used_delta // parent_gas_target // BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR, 1) ``` That is on the way up. Thanks 😄 It ensures that we can always increment by *at least* one, even if we are below 8. Oh, sorry. You were talking about the gas target... 🤔 Currently, the gas target formula should be unchanged from before 1559. So I *think* we already have this problem right now? Okay maybe it is actually the case. We can set a gas target of 1023 right? Then we are stuck Because of that, I would suggest someone create a separate EIP for it. FWIW, a gas target below 10,500 will result in zero transactions being able to go through. Presumably, before that point the core devs would step in and push out a hard fork. The gas target doesn't change too fast. It is an extremely unrealistic situation Maybe there is actually a minimum gas limit, I'll check Ah yes there is. The minimum gas limit is 5k, so there won't be a problem (otherwise we'd have this problem as well as in the miners adjusting the gas limit) Oh, someone should probably update the 1559 spec to make it clear that the block size code shouldn't change. PRs welcome. 😬

excerpts.content:
